description.value: Gotham Steakhouse is a long-established downtown Vancouver institution, celebrating 25 years as of 2024, housed in an opulent art deco dining room of mahogany and soaring windows. The kitchen serves exclusively Canada Prime grade beef alongside fresh seafood, hand-crafted cocktails, and a deep award-winning wine cellar. Private dining rooms — the Club Room (up to 32 guests) and the intimate Boardroom (up to 20) — make it a destination for group dining as well as solo indulgence.
